# `network/realm/shield/RealmShield.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/realm/shield/RealmShield.js`

Runtime isolation, quotas, moderation, and tamper-evident audit for Realm entry.

## Classes

### `class RealmShield`

Realm Shield is deliberately local. It applies signed Gate plans but stores no Realm authority and performs no server-side enforcement.
